transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I decided to come in because I've been having a bit of a hard time lately. What finally scared me into making this appointment is that I’ve started having these thoughts... just things like, "If I didn’t wake up tomorrow, that might be easier." 

I want to be clear that I don’t actually want to hurt myself. I really don't. But just having those kinds of thoughts pop into my head was unsettling enough that I figured I needed to talk to someone about it.
How long have you been having these kinds of thoughts?
I'm not exactly sure when they started, to be honest. It hasn't been going on for a really long time, maybe just recently I started noticing them more. It's hard to pinpoint an exact day or week.
How would you describe your mood lately?

Well, it's been pretty low. Most mornings lately, I wake up with this... this heavy, gray feeling. It's almost like the color has just drained out of everything before I even get dressed for the store. It's just a very flat, down kind of mood.
Have you found yourself enjoying things you typically like to do, or has that changed lately?

It's definitely changed. I mean, I still try to do the things I usually enjoy. Like, I'll set out my paints on the table, or I'll even think about going to my pottery class. But... when I actually sit down with the materials, I just kind of stare at them. That spark I used to feel, that excitement to create something... it's just not there at all right now.
Have you been experiencing any unusual worries or fears lately?
No, not really. I mean, I have the normal everyday things I think about, but... no unusual worries or strange fears. I haven't noticed anything out of the ordinary like that.
How long have you been feeling this low mood?

Well, this low, flat feeling... it's been going on for about six months now. It's been long enough that the things I usually do to feel better, like my art classes or taking a morning walk, just haven't been helping at all.
Have you lost interest in activities you usually enjoy?

Like I was mentioning a minute ago with my painting and the pottery class... yes, I definitely have. I just don't have the desire to actually do them right now. I still go through the motions of setting things up, but that genuine interest I used to have is just gone.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight recently?
No, I haven't noticed any real changes there. My weight has stayed pretty much the same... my clothes all still fit the way they usually do.
Do you still feel pleasure when you're doing things that you used to enjoy, even if you don't feel like doing them?
No, not really. Even when I push myself to go to the class or try to paint, I just... I don't get any joy out of it anymore. It just feels like a chore.
Have you noticed any changes in how active or restless you feel, or if you've been feeling slowed down lately?

Well, it kind of goes back and forth. Some days I'm just restless... I catch myself pacing around the living room or picking at my cuticles without even realizing it. But then other times, it's the opposite. Even just walking from the break room out to the sales floor at work feels... I don't know, strangely slow. Like I'm moving through water or something.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or enjoy, even if it's just a little bit?

Honestly, no. I've tried to think if there's something, but... there really isn't right now. Everything just feels kind of flat. Even the little things I usually like to do to unwind when I get home from the store, I just don't get any enjoyment out of them at the moment.
Are there any small things that still bring you a bit of happiness?

Not really, no. I mean, I still try. I'll set out my paints at home, or I'll think about going to my pottery class... but then I just sit there. I'll stare at the materials and... I don't know, I just feel none of the spark I used to feel. It's just gone.
Have you experienced periods of significant depression like this before?
No, I haven't. I mean, I've had days where I felt a little down, like anyone else, but nothing like this. This... this heavy, empty feeling where nothing matters? It's completely new to me.
Are there any activities that you still look forward to?

Like I was just saying a minute ago, not really. I might try to look forward to things, like getting my paints ready or planning to go to that pottery class... but it always ends the same way. I just sit there and stare at the materials, and that spark I used to have is just completely gone. So, no, there isn't really anything I look forward to right now.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in usually pleasurable activities over the past two weeks?

Yes, definitely. Like I mentioned, it's been happening a lot lately. I'll get everything ready for my painting, or I'll tell myself I'm going to my pottery class, but the interest just isn't there anymore. I just end up staring at my supplies. The enjoyment I used to get from it is just completely missing right now.
How long have you been feeling this way, with the low mood and loss of interest in activities, without any significant improvement?

It's been about six months now. That low, flat feeling just kind of settled in and hasn't really let up. It's definitely been long enough that all my usual routines, you know, my art classes and even just my morning walks... they just stopped feeling restorative a while ago.
Have you had any periods in your life where you felt significantly depressed before this current episode?
No, not that I can remember. I mean, I've had days where I felt a bit down or stressed, like anyone else, but nothing like this. This is the first time it's been this bad and lasted this long.
Have you had any other episodes like this in your past, where you felt similarly depressed?
No, like I just mentioned, I really haven't. This is... well, this is the first time in my life I've ever felt this way. So, no, nothing like this in the past.
Have you had more than one episode of feeling this depressed in your life?
No, I really haven't. Like I said, this is the very first time I've ever dealt with something like this. I've never had another period in my life where I felt this low.
Have you ever felt as depressed as you do now before this current episode?

I feel like we might be going in circles a bit here. But no, I haven't. Like I've been saying, I have never experienced anything like this before now. This is absolutely the first time in my life I've ever felt this depressed.
